answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. An identity earns only when its dawn recurs, its copper survives audit, and a sonnet from an unlinked peer confirms it.
